body.cap: VIP attendees pose for a commemorative photo at the opening ceremony of the 2025 Future Innovation Tech Expo (FIX 2025) held at EXCO on October 22 (Wednesday). | Photo by AVING News

body.x: Daegu Metropolitan City held the opening ceremony of the 2025 Future Innovation Tech Expo (FIX 2025) at EXCO on October 22 (Wednesday) under the theme “The Future Has Already Begun, All on AI.”

The ceremony was attended by more than 130 distinguished guests from Korea and abroad, including Acting Mayor Jeong-gi Kim of Daegu, Hee Up Kang, Vice Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, Seung-ryeol Lee, Director-General for Industrial Policy at the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy, Mangyu Lee, Chairman of Daegu City Council, National Assembly Member In-seon Lee (Chair of the People Power Party’s Daegu Chapter), Brian McMurray, President of GMTCK, Jean-Pierre Hathout, CEO of Universal Robots, Yoon Ki Kim, CEO of HL Robotics, Seung-mo Kim, CEO of Hanwha E&C, Sheal Eum, CEO of AeiROBOT, and Tim Hwang, founder of FiscalNote.

The line tour that followed the opening ceremony offered visitors an opportunity to explore cutting-edge innovations across EXCO’s East and West Halls. Highlights included T-Money’s “Tagless Payment System,” Hyundai Motor’s next-generation hydrogen and electric vehicle lineup, HL Robotics’ autonomous parking robot demonstration, the AI Mobility Innovation Hall, a special UAM Pavilion, AeiROBOT representing Korea’s humanoid robotics excellence, and Unitree’s first-ever demonstration of humanoid boxing in Korea.

In the afternoon, Wang Tan, Vice President of XPeng AeroHT, delivered a keynote address titled “Pioneering the Future with 3D Mobility.” He was followed by Seyoung (Noah) Lee, CEO of wrtn technologies—the leading domestic generative AI service platform—Jean-Pierre Hathout, CEO of Universal Robots, Seungmin Baek, Head of LG Electronics’ Advanced Robotics Lab, Professor Jaekweon Han, a leading expert in humanoid robotics, and Professor Gautam Kamath from the Vector Institute for Artificial Intelligence, co-founded by deep learning pioneer Geoffrey Hinton.

body.cap: Acting Mayor Jeong-gi Kim of Daegu and VIP attendees tour the exhibition hall during the opening ceremony of FIX 2025 at EXCO on October 22 (Wednesday). | Photo by AVING News

body.x: Visitors also enjoyed interactive experiences such as riding the XPeng UAM “X2,” watching Unitree’s humanoid boxing performance, and viewing Top Robotics’ humanoid soccer demonstration.

In the East Hall lobby, where the mobility exhibition zone was located, classic cars ranging from the Ford Model T—the first mass-produced car to use a conveyor belt—to the Porsche 356, once driven by actor James Dean, were displayed. Test drives of electric vehicles from BYD, Hyundai, and MOTREX were also available.

FIX 2025 runs from October 22 (Wednesday) to 25 (Saturday), open daily from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. (closing at 5 p.m. on Saturday). To enhance convenience for out-of-town visitors, shuttle buses operate every 15 minutes between Dongdaegu Station and EXCO.

In his opening remarks, Acting Mayor Jeong-gi Kim stated, “As FIX marks its second edition this year, we have strengthened the connection between industry and AI to align with Korea’s national goal of becoming a top AI powerhouse while driving large-scale transformation across regional industries. As reflected in our main theme, ‘The Future Has Already Begun, All on AI,’ this expo focuses on AI as its core. It is designed to explore AI-driven innovation across mobility, robotics, and ICT, setting a clear direction toward a technology ecosystem centered on AI.”

body.cap: Acting Mayor Jeong-gi Kim delivers his opening address during the opening ceremony of FIX 2025 at EXCO on October 22 (Wednesday). | Photo by AVING News

body.x: He added, “FIX is not merely an exhibition—it is a meaningful venue to share Daegu’s vision for industrial innovation, built upon the city’s long-term efforts to restructure its industrial ecosystem, and to reaffirm our commitment to new challenges.”

FIX 2025 serves as an integrated platform for future innovation technologies, bringing together advancements in future mobility, robotics, AI, and semiconductors. Under the slogan “The Future Already Begun, All on AI,” the exhibition will feature the Daegu International Future Auto & Mobility Expo, Daegu Robot Expo, and ICT Convergence Expo Korea, along with conferences, business programs, side events, and cultural experiences.

At the Daegu International Future Auto & Mobility Expo, eco-friendly mobility, next-generation vehicles, secondary batteries, and components will be exhibited. The Daegu Robot Expo will showcase a range of products, including industrial robots, service robots, robot components, AR/VR, AI, IoT, and drones. The ICT Convergence Expo Korea will present metaverse and platform technologies, digital content systems, smart devices, cybersecurity, and ICT convergence services. Startup platforms, including Plug and Play Korea Expo 2025, Startup Arena, and the Global Innovator Festa (GIF), will also be held.
